title: PowerShell Script Block Logging is Disabled
description: Script Block Logging captures complete, de-obfuscated script code blocks into Event ID 4104 for threat detection and incident response.
impact: Living-off-the-land PowerShell attacks, encoded download cradles, and memory injection cannot be investigated post-incident.
remediation_guidance: Enable Script Block Logging via GPO or Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell\ScriptBlockLogging' -Name 'EnableScriptBlockLogging' -Value 1

compliance_mappings.title: Turn on PowerShell Script Block Logging

title: PowerShell Execution Policy is Set to Unrestricted or Bypass
description: Execution Policy provides basic defense against accidental execution of unvetted scripts downloaded from the Internet.
impact: Downloaded untrusted scripts can run without digital signature verification or zone checks.
